前往圖庫查看更多](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/chicknturtles-3d-tools/gallery) --- [![ChicknTurtle](https://img.shields.io/badge/-ChicknTurtle-f16436?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&labelColor=black&color=f16436)](https://www.curseforge.com/members/ChicknTurtle) [![ChicknTurtle](https://img.shields.io/badge/ChicknTurtle-a?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&labelColor=black&color=1bd96a)](https://modrinth.com/user/ChicknTurtle) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1151910?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&labelColor=black&color=f16436)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/chicknturtles-3d-tools) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/8ZVNGHGD?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&labelColor=black&color=1bd96a)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/chicknturtles-3d-tools) ## 功能特色 ⚔️ 簡約的 3D 模型，適用於： 劍、斧頭、鎬子、鏟子、鋤頭、連枷與三叉戟 ## 資訊 只要未修改工具的模型，即可與其他資源包相容 目前不支援任何模組工具 模型使用 [Blockbench](https://www.blockbench.net/) 製作 --- [![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/8Gv9gm22/dcbdc1fc77706ed17f81436220214b3993d0734f_96.webp)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/chicknturtles-3d-totems) [![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/vlbXWQ2k/45845988021373eca428a6ef2b9edf4241fc8ba3_96.webp)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/chicknturtles-better-shield) [![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/4fU34F4v/02d76ca13a36c6ef976865b756839bc75862dd24_96.webp)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/numbered-levels) **💚 記得追蹤！**
